title_en: Stories of Modern China (4/20): The Water Town's Last Year
note_en: In 老陈把这次拍的照片做成了一本书 "Old Chen turned the photos he took this time into a book," 把 moves the object (the photos) in front of the verb to show what was done to it and how it ended up. A 把 sentence needs a result after the verb, here 做成 "make into"; a bare 把照片做 would feel unfinished. The same pattern appears in 政府把移民统一安置到县城 "the government resettled the relocated residents in the county seat."
